title: MVN Group Signs Design Consultancy Contract for My Dinh PEAR – PEAR 3 and the Overall Project Sales Documentation
description: MVN Group Signs Design Consultancy Contract with SSG Group for My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3 and the Overall Project Sales Documentation. This milestone marks a significant step forward in affirming MVN Group’s expertise in architectural consultancy, product development, and its commitment to accompanying large-scale high-rise real estate projects.
author: MVN Group
content:
On May 26, 2025, in Hanoi, Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, a member of SSG Group (SSG Group), held a signing ceremony for the contract for the design consultancy package for My Dinh PEAR – PEAR 3 and the overall project sales documentation with MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group).

This is an important milestone in the cooperation between the two companies, further affirming the Client’s confidence in the professional capabilities, practical experience, and design thinking of MVN Group in the field of high-rise building project development.

 

 

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Project: My Dinh PEAR – PEAR 3
Location: 01 Chau Van Liem, Nam Tu Liem, Hanoi
Site Area: 3.8 hectares
Building Density: 24.87%
Residential Building Density: 18.25%
Residential Floor Area: 15,992 m²
Scale: 951 apartments

The project is part of the overall My Dinh PEAR development, in which PEARL 1 and PEARL 2 have been completed, creating an important foundation for the continued development of PEARL 3 and the completion of the project’s overall image.

With the advantages of its location, scale, and established product system, the PEARL 3 phase and the overall project sales documentation require a high level of consistency in architecture, imagery, functionality, and the ability to communicate the product’s value to the market.

LEADERSHIP OF THE TWO COMPANIES ATTEND THE SIGNING CEREMONY

The signing ceremony was attended by:

  • Mr. Phan Le Anh – General Director of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, Member of the Board of Directors of SSG Group.

  • Mr. Hoang Huu Son – Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company, a member of SSG Group.

  • Mr. Truong Anh Vuong – General Director of MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group).

  • Mr. Do Tan Dat – Project Director of MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group).

The presence of the leadership of both companies demonstrates the importance placed on the project, while also creating a foundation for close coordination throughout the stages of research, concept development, design, and completion of the sales documentation.

SHARING FROM THE CLIENT – SSG

Through the process of discussion, research, and design development, the direction proposed by the MVN team fully convinced the Client, demonstrating the ability to transform project requirements into a product that balances architectural quality, aesthetics, functionality, and operational efficiency.

Mr. Phan Le Anh – General Director of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, Member of the Board of Directors of SSG Group

Very satisfied with and highly appreciative of the professional capabilities and practical experience of the MVN Group team, especially in the field of high-rise apartment building design.

Ms. Ho Thi Thuy Phuong – Head of Sales Department, Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG

Highly appreciates the professional capabilities, collaborative spirit, and working efficiency of the MVN Group team.

According to her, MVN not only demonstrates strong architectural and aesthetic thinking, but also approaches the project from the perspective of products and the market, with a focus on functionality, customer experience, and development and sales potential.

The team’s proactive coordination, prompt responses, and good reception of practical requirements have contributed to completing the design approach in a direction that is aesthetically appealing, suitable for the market, and highly applicable.

In addition to practical implementation experience, the professional awards and achievements that MVN has attained in the field of high-rise architecture are also one of the important bases for the Client to assess the capabilities of the consultancy firm.

This recognition is a motivation for MVN to continue developing its professional strengths and accompanying SSG in the development of My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3, as well as in completing the overall image of the project.

CREATING VALUE FROM ARCHITECTURE TO REAL ESTATE PRODUCTS

 

 

For MVN Group, designing a real estate project is not merely a matter of architectural form, but also a comprehensive process of studying functionality, user experience, product value, and investment efficiency.

For PEARL 3, MVN aims to develop the design approach in a direction that is modern, distinctive, functionally optimized, and enhances product value, while ensuring harmony with the overall PEARL 1 and PEARL 2 developments that have already been completed.

Alongside the design consultancy, the overall project sales documentation will be studied in a direction that ensures consistency in imagery and information, helping to clearly communicate the project’s outstanding values to customers and the market.

This is a combination of architecture – imagery – product information – market-oriented thinking, aiming to create a unified system of identity and communication for the entire project.

CONTINUING THE JOURNEY OF ACCOMPANYING LARGE-SCALE PROJECTS

With a team of experienced architects, engineers, and specialists, MVN Group pursues the direction of creating architectural solutions that are high-quality, distinctive, and of long-term value.

Being trusted by SSG to undertake the design consultancy package for My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3 and the overall project sales documentation is an important milestone, further affirming MVN’s capabilities in the field of high-rise real estate design and product development.

MVN Group sincerely appreciates the trust of SSG Group and is committed to accompanying the project with professional capabilities, a sense of responsibility, and creative thinking, toward a product that simultaneously meets the following values:

ARCHITECTURE – AESTHETICS – FUNCTIONALITY – QUALITY – OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY.
